cpu: AMD Ryzen 7 5825U with Radeon Graphics, 16 logical processors exposed
storage: /dev/sdd, ext4 on a WSL virtual disk
method: Three sequential repetitions; 16,384 keys; 4/64 KiB values; sync every 128 operations; two update/delete rounds; fresh process per phase; alternate engine order. baseline_harness: Same workload-v2 benchmark source linked against commit 87e4eae for paired same-file reopen comparisons.
rocksdb_runtime: Default options except create_if_missing and compression=kNoCompression; WriteOptions.sync=true; 128-operation WriteBatch; PinnableSlice copied into owned buffer; explicit Flush(wait=true) and CompactRange.
